lead: Ditse is a reading site. I collect as little as I can.

sections.heading: What I collect
sections.body: Nothing, unless you write to me. If you use the contact form, post a comment or email me, I keep your name, email address and message so I can reply or publish your comment. Your email is never shown.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: Visits are counted in aggregate to understand which stories are read. This data is not tied to your name or used to profile you.

sections.heading: Cookies
sections.body: The site uses only the cookies it needs to work and to measure visits. You can block them in your browser; every story stays readable.

sections.heading: Sharing
sections.body: I do not sell or rent your information. When you use a share button, the service you share to handles your data under its own policy.

sections.heading: Keeping and deleting
sections.body: Messages are kept only as long as a conversation needs. Email me and I will delete what I hold about you, including a published comment.

sections.heading: Changes
sections.body: If this policy changes, the date above changes with it.
